description: This file contains utility functions and constants for scanning repository files and runtime source files, including patterns to skip certain files, functions to list files with specific extensions, and cache management for performance optimization.

methods.name: listRepoFiles
methods.description: Asynchronously lists files in a repository based on specified roots, extensions, and filtering options.

methods.name: listRuntimeSourceFiles
methods.description: Asynchronously lists runtime source files, utilizing caching and filtering based on skip patterns.

methods.name: shouldSkipRuntimeSourcePath
methods.description: Determines if a given relative path should be skipped based on predefined patterns.
